newsitem.title: INDIA: OPINION-WEEKLY TECHNICAL ANALYSIS OF BOMBAY SHARE INDEX.
newsitem.headline: OPINION-WEEKLY TECHNICAL ANALYSIS OF BOMBAY SHARE INDEX.

text.p: ALMOST ALL COUNTERS KICK INTO POSITION is a trend
analysis of the 30-share Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) index for the period December 9 to 13 by analyst Mehmood Khan at Times Guaranty Financials Ltd

Trading for the week ended on a steady note, with a loss of 64.30 points (2.22 percent) at 2826.20 levels over the previous week. From among the charts scanned after Friday's trading, the technical feature of majority of the pivotals, appears to be best for pyramiding in the correction. The interim rally has triggered off at 2713.12 levels has a maximum target of 2930-2970 levels.

Friday saw the index rally marginally leading to the formation of the support pivot at 2793.75. With this, one is probably into the third corrective phase 6-7 of the ongoing bearishness. The index is close to the 38.2 percent retracement level (from 3035.64 to 2713.12). The bearish trend would become neutral above 2894.54 for the week's trading. On the downside, the bearish trend would be reconfirmed if the index declines below 2771.17 levels.

The Sensex pierced the January '96 low of 2820.26 on 4th December, as predicted by the TIMES GUARANTY. The sharp reversal was due at the said level (2730) was highlighted by Reuters on Wednesday before the trading session. The Sensex has staged a rally of 130 points from the low of 2713.12, this may be classified as the bottom of this calendar year. The interim recovery has a maximum target of 2930-2970.

This target lies in the Fibonacci retracement level of 61.8-80 percent, of the immediate decline from 3035.64 to 2713.12. The cluster of resistance are emerging at the 1x2 Fan lines (63.75 degrees) drawn by taking 4131.22 as the top. The Sensex has taken support at the 4x1 (15 degrees) trend fan lines from 1980.06 on the weekly bar chart.

The minor bottom at 2713.12, has retraced the decline of 322.52 points (3035.64 - 2713.12) by approximately 38.2 percent. The present rally has the potential strength of another 100-150 points and may falter at 2930-2970 levels. The assumption is being justified by the positive divergence's available on the majority of the average composite stocks on the monthly and weekly charts. But the minor correction of 70-110 points from the resistance pivot of 2874-2905 levels cannot be ruled out.

The price following oscillators on the weekly bar chart are exhibiting that the top may be formed at 2930-2970 levels - Relative Strength Index (14 RSI) is 30.67, Price Rate of Change (12 ROC) is placed at -15.67, short term stochastic is hovering at 12.35 and its trigger line is at 19.14, while the medium term stochastic is 15.64 and the trigger is 19.76, the Macd is -153.55 with the trigger exhibiting long term bearishness at -109.64 & the 14 William's percent R positively placed at -87.05.

For the current week, the BSE Sensex may encounter resistance at 2874-2915 levels, on the lower end it may find support at 2793-2765 levels. The National Index may witness profit booking at 1287-1305 levels and support at 1231 and 1221 levels.
(The opinions expressed in this article reflect the views of the author only. They should not be taken as reflecting the views of Reuters).
